Privacy notice

Last updated: 22 November 2026

Aditusan is the personal portfolio website of Aditya Varma. This notice explains the information involved when you visit aditusan.dev. Linked applications and websites may have their own privacy notices.

Website preferences

This website uses your browser’s local storage to remember your season, day or night appearance, and reduced-motion preferences. These settings stay in your browser and are used to personalise the website’s presentation. You can remove them by clearing this website’s stored data in your browser.

Hosting

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs and stores visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes. More information is available in the GitHub Privacy Statement.

Advertising

This website uses Google AdSense. Google and other advertising providers may use cookies and similar technologies to deliver ads, measure their performance, and detect fraud. Information processed may include your IP address, browser or device information, and interactions with advertisements.

Advertising cookies can allow Google and its partners to personalise ads using visits to this website and other websites. Personalisation depends on your consent, applicable requirements, and advertising settings.

Learn more about how Google uses information from partner websites and read Google’s Privacy Policy. The consent message, where displayed, identifies the advertising providers and purposes involved.

Your privacy choices

Where a consent message is displayed, you can accept, decline, or manage the available choices. To revisit your decision, use “Privacy & cookie settings” in the homepage footer when available.

You can also manage personalised advertising through Google My Ad Center and participating providers through YourAdChoices. These choices do not necessarily remove all advertising.

Your browser also provides controls for cookies and website storage. Clearing stored data may reset your preferences and consent choices.

Other websites

Links to applications, repositories, and other websites take you to services with their own data practices. Please review their privacy notices when using them.

Contact and updates

For questions about this notice or requests concerning your personal information, contact Aditya Varma at adityavarma2106.pwap@gmail.com. Information you send will be used to respond to your request and retained as needed to handle it.

This notice may change as the website develops. Updates will appear here with a revised date.
